name: Off-cycle bonus taxed inside the month it is paid (FR-PAY-19)
source: synthetic — replace with anonymised real cases
derivation: A bonus of 20,000,000 is then paid in the same August by an off-cycle run. Progressive tax is a tax on the month, not on the payment, so the bonus run taxes the month as a whole and withholds only the difference.
The deductions are given once, by the month: employee insurance 3,150,000 (contributed by the regular run) and the personal deduction 15,500,000. No dependants.

This run withholds 2,770,000 - 635,000 (already withheld) = 2,135,000. Taxing the bonus on its own would have been wrong in both directions: it ignores the brackets already used and takes the deductions twice.
No insurance on an off-cycle run: the month's contribution was made once, on the declared salary.
There is no salary structure and no attendance in this run, and neither is a warning: an off-cycle run is not a month.
